_note: The default one-pager. Copy this file to <company>.json and tune `summary`, the chosen bullet ids, and any `text` overrides for a specific job description. Every bullet id must exist in content/career.json — the renderer fails on unknown ids, which is what stops invented claims. This base variant is DOMAIN-NEUTRAL: healthcare standards are trimmed to one item. For a healthcare role, copy it and add the 'domain' skills group and the FHIR/OMOP highlights back.
summary: Senior software engineer, five years on distributed backends where correctness is not optional - service integration, event-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure, access control and applied ML. Owns systems from design to the CI/CD that ships them.

bullets.text: Built the integration hub's base adapter modules, turning every new integration from a bespoke build into a pattern
Designed and shipped a full RBAC system: admin-only endpoints, per-role response filtering and pre-authorization checks
Mapped business entitlements onto Microsoft Entra identity, enforcing endpoint and data-level access through JWT claims
Remediated static-analysis security findings and led a security overhaul separating study-team and participant concerns
Cut the backend deploy pipeline from 26m33s to 18m07s (-32%)
Reduced a service container image from 450 MB to 290 MB (-36%) by eliminating unneeded dependencies
Eliminated $200+/month (~$2.4k/year) of idle cloud spend by decommissioning legacy services, then added a billing review
Modelled clinical protocols and surveys on FHIR resources with OMOP/LOINC terminology; change logs via FHIR provenance
Drove requirements directly with the client, turning whiteboard sessions into wireframed workflows and E2E implementation
Cut the deployable image from 19 GB to 5.28 GB (-72%) through packaging design
Designed the codebase so the third-party model ships with the system and its licence swaps on expiry without a rebuild
Onboarded two junior engineers and led the project through a stretch when tech leads were unavailable

prior_text.bl-observability: Built out monitoring and log management: Graylog for structured logging, Sentry APM across the Flask and Node.js services
prior_text.bl-mathsteps: Core maintainer of the open-source mathsteps library; added complex expression support and improved parsing accuracy
prior_text.dl-statemachine: Extended the integration layer of an AWS Step Functions state machine, building the API calls and Lambda functions behind it
prior_text.dl-rollout: Built the integrations each additional US state needed to move onto the new platform, which made the rollouts faster
